reason: The cited evidence shows that annealing alone improves strength and ductility (E1) and that phase decomposition in a processed lamellar structure enhances strength–ductility synergy (E3), but none of the passages mention cryo-rolling, cryogenic deformation, creep resistance, or corrosion performance. The specific claims about dislocation accumulation from cryo-rolling, coherent nanoprecipitate formation, and multi-property improvements are therefore unsupported by the cited prior work.
premises: Heavy cryo-rolling introduces high dislocation densities in AlCoCrFeNi2.1
Subsequent annealing triggers controlled phase decomposition of the lamellar structure
Phase decomposition and recrystallization produce ultrafine grains and coherent nanoprecipitates
Coherent nanoprecipitates and refined structure simultaneously increase strength, ductility, creep resistance, and corrosion resistance
The proposed processing yields a 20–40% strength increase and ~2× ductility improvement over the as-cast state
